newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: STIC to buy ST Logistics in share swap.
newsitem.headline: STIC to buy ST Logistics in share swap.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd (STIC) said on Friday it was proposing to acquire the remaining 50 percent stake in Singapore Technologies Logistics Pte Ltd through a share swap.
Singapore Technologies Pte Ltd (STPL) would transfer to STIC five million shares of S$1.00 each in exchange for 25.5 million shares at S$0.25 each of ST Capital Ltd, STIC said in a statement.
ST Capital is the financial arm of STIC.
ST Logistics provides freight forwarding, warehousing and purchasing services.
STIC had acquired a 50 percent stake in ST Logistics in 1994 as part of a move to provide an integrated centre for its regional infrastructure development projects.
After the proposed acquisition, STPL's direct interest in ST Capital would rise to 28.7 percent from 11 percent.
The ST Capital shares to be transferred to STPL have been given a value of S$1.95 per share, based on the transacted price of ST Capital shares on April 21, 1997.
Following the acquisition, STIC's stake in ST Capital will be reduced to 42.1 percent from 59.8 percent.
ST Capital will become an associate of STIC after the share swap.
